events.title: Kids Workshop
events.instagramCaption:
A place to try, create, play and have fun.
Art Play is an open-ended art experience for children aged 3+, where they can explore materials, follow their ideas, get creative and enjoy making things together.
✨ Explore new ideas
✨ Create freely
✨ Get messy & express
✨ Have fun & connect
📅 3rd • 17th • 31st October
⏰ 10:00 AM – 12:00 PM
📍 Eravoo, Jayanagar
👧 For ages 3+
💰 ₹6,000 for the month
🎨 All materials provided
We’ll be using a mix of natural and recyclable materials for children to explore and create with.
Please bring a water bottle and a light snack.
🔗 Link in bio to register
💌 Or DM us to register.
